text:
Ravi (ML): heads-up: after the q2-int8 rollout a subset of multi-turn prompts show brittle outputs. pattern: HTML-escaped fragments + slight de-dup misses -> amplified quant errors. want to stand up a small curated set and a normalization/dedupe pipeline pass.
Evelyn: yup saw that too. EM gap ~10pts on long-history cases.
Noah: hypothesis: ingestion preserved HTML entities and nonbreaking spaces => tokenizer differences. we should normalize before fuzzy dedupe.
Priya: propose workflow: normalize -> fuzzyhash cluster -> sample stratified by token_count -> manual label microgolden (250 rows). can do labels: PASS/FAIL + reason tag + canonical_answer.
Ben (Infra): I can add job hook to benchbot. what model variants do you want compared?
Ravi (ML): q2-int8, q6, fp16. also test with and without kv-cache enabled. bench flags: `--models=q2-int8,q6,fp16 --kv-cache=(on|off) --batch=1,4`.
Evelyn: small SQL to pull candidates:
```sql
select id, text, char_length(text) as chars, array_length(tokize(text)) as toks from ingest.prompts where created_at > '2025-11-01' order by random() limit 15000;
```
Noah: normalization script I'll run: `python ingest/normalize_texts.py --in raw.jsonl --out norm.jsonl --html-unescape --nbspace-to-space --unicode-nfkc`.
CurateBot: pipeline `norm+fuzzy/3812345678` created by Noah at 2026-01-14T09:12:03Z - 14.9k candidates queued.
Priya: labeling plan: 250 rows -> stratify short(100)/mid(100)/long(50). labels: PASS/FAIL, severity(1-3), canonical_answer, tags(compression,html,dup-origin,kvcache). CSV path: `/datasets/microgoldens/normalizer-bridge-2026.csv`. schema: `id,text,tokens,label,severity,canonical,notes,tags,source`.
Ravi (ML): add `kvcache` boolean column too. annotate whether example hits kv window.
Ben (Infra): benchbot will run on canary infra; estimate 35m per model variant with kv permutations. I'll queue after label drop.
Evelyn: also capture logits for the golden responses to help root cause regressions (use `--dump-logits`).
Noah: dedupe parameters: `fuzzyhash --sim 0.9 --min-shingles 5 --keep-representative=true`. we'll keep one canonical per cluster and include `cluster_id` and `orig_ids` in the CSV.
Priya: I'll start labeling tomorrow morning, will flag ambiguous as `needs-triage`. assign ticket ML-2584.
Ravi (ML): good. after labeling we run: `tools/run_eval.py --gold /datasets/microgoldens/normalizer-bridge-2026.csv --models q2-int8,q6,fp16 --out /runs/normalizer-bridge-2026/results.json --metrics em,bleu,ae`. open quick PR if long bucket EM drops >5pt.
CurateBot: job `bench/normalizer-bridge-3812345678` scheduled by Ben at 2026-01-14T10:05:21Z.
Noah: small note: keep `source` column (e.g., user-uploads, web-scrape, partner-ingest) so we can trace dup origins. I'm adding that to the dedupe export.
Evelyn: also include `html_escape_fraction` heuristic field (0-1) so we can filter high-html-noise examples.
Priya: acknowledged. ETA for labeled CSV: 2026-01-14 EOD PST. I'll upload to repo and ping here.
Ravi (ML): thanks. if bench shows regressions we'll try short-term mitigations: 1) HTML normalizer in ingest, 2) increase fuzzy sim threshold, 3) disable q2-int8 for longctx canary. we'll document and iterate. :thumbsup:
